## Generate output and figure dir

```{r}
output_dir <- "../outputs/"
figure_dir <- "../outputs/Paper_Figures/"
multi_omics_dir <- "../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/"

if(!dir.exists(output_dir)){dir.create(output_dir)}
if(!dir.exists(figure_dir)){dir.create(figure_dir)}
if(!dir.exists(multi_omics_dir)){dir.create(multi_omics_dir)}

```

## Generate omic dir

```{r}
omic_ids_vect <- c("RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation",
              "Histone_Modifications_Proteomics", "Untargeted_Metabolomics",
               "Targeted_Metabolomics", "Metallomics", "Shotgun_metagenomics")


lapply(omic_ids_vect, function(omic_id){
    omic_dir <- paste0("../outputs/", omic_id, "/")
    if(!dir.exists(omic_dir)){dir.create(omic_dir)}
    
    omic_input_dir <- paste0("../inputs/", omic_id, "/")
    
    omic_outputs_lima <- paste0(omic_dir, omic_id, "_exp_lima.rds")
    omic_outputs_gfcv <- paste0(omic_dir, omic_id, "_exp_gfcv.rds")
    
    if(!file.exists(omic_outputs_gfcv) | !file.exists(omic_outputs_lima)){
        script_path <- paste0(omic_dir, omic_id, "_script.Rmd")
        script_output_name <- paste0(omic_id, "_script.html")
        
        xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render, 
            args = list(input = script_path, 
                      output_file = script_output_name, 
                      params = list(
                        input_dir = omic_input_dir,
                        output_dir = omic_dir)
                    )
            )
    }
})

multi_omics_prepro_script_path <- paste0(multi_omics_dir, "Multi_Omics_Processing.Rmd")
multi_omics_prepro_script_name <- "Multi_Omics_Processing.html"

xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render, 
            args = list(input = multi_omics_prepro_script_path, 
                      output_file = multi_omics_prepro_script_name, 
                      params = list(
                        input_dir = omic_input_dir,
                        output_dir = omic_dir)
                    )
            )

multi_omics_script_path_gfcv <- paste0(multi_omics_dir, "Multi_Omics_Analysis_GFCV.Rmd")
multi_omics_script_name_gfcv <- "Multi_Omics_Analysis_GFCV.html"

xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render, 
            args = list(input = multi_omics_script_path_gfcv, 
                      output_file = multi_omics_script_name_gfcv, 
                      params = list(
                        input_dir = "../../inputs/",
                        output_dir = omic_dir)
                    )
            )


multi_omics_script_path <- paste0(multi_omics_dir, "Multi_Omics_Analysis.Rmd")
multi_omics_script_name <- "Multi_Omics_Analysis.html"

xfun::Rscript_call(rmarkdown::render, 
            args = list(input = multi_omics_script_path, 
                      output_file = multi_omics_script_name, 
                      params = list(
                        output_dir = omic_dir)
                    )
            )

```
